gates.G1: every tactical policy, every level: collisions <= DIRECT and gained == 0
gates.G3: >=5% diverge >=1 m AND (>=10 conversions OR |mean min-sep diff|>=0.25 m); positive: conversions >= reversals
gates.G5: 0 plans without info, 0 ids outside perceived, 0 forbidden references, DIRECT == A0
gates.G6: finite, deterministic replay, route run <= 40 steps, <= 3 plans in 4 steps

lockout_rule: after a route completion the controller stays DIRECT for one replan interval (added after a 4-scenario smoke test, before any sweep)

observation.countdown: route: steps until the cadence expires / replan_steps; DIRECT: post-completion hold remaining / replan_steps
observation.progress: 1 - |subgoal - p_a| / initial distance to the subgoal, 1 after it is passed, 0 in DIRECT

planner: uav_defend.obstacles.route_planner.build_and_search_route (existing visibility-graph + A*, perceived static obstacles only)
